title: Exclude two simultaneous Type B phase transfers (0% κ change)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN. Exact conditional κ change 0%.** All 1,950 ways to demote two original Type B singleton odd idles and promote two larger even idles on exact #7113 change the endpoint at q = −1 and unit body. Every original clock, role, body mask, J block and other event is retained. Modular and independent exact rational checks agree on every key, including overlapping body masks. Both exhausted the scope with zero survivors and zero unresolved cases.

The complete 17-copy #7314 invoice prices 110,536 paid and 22,461 productive positions, with rank surplus 1,424 and no empty-root credit. The exact directed price was saved before endpoint decoding. The optimistic two-transfer upper is 0.11648618439752845 raw units. One additional raw paid rank-one position eliminates the price-only margin. The compatible saving upper after support is zero.

## Task and overlap

Round 59 of Discussion #7111. Canonical base e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57, independently reproduced #7314 head 9d0119eb12fbd9fa534b48cd37b68e7099757b91 at κ = 0.003646221436446, and exact #7113 caller 07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d. #7317 excludes one transfer and leaves joint cancellation open. #3204 studies an older four-site rigidity question on a different schedule. #1324 supplies an older simultaneous axis reassignment on a different supplier. This branch retains the exact #7257 replay prerequisites.

## Validation

From a clean checkout with CPython 3.12 and assertions enabled:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-two-type-b-phase-transfers
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-two-type-b-phase-transfers --check-modes --check-source-history
```

Registered replay, commit byte/mode/source authentication, Git-free export replay and six navigation tests passed locally. The package authenticates the comparator closure, reproduces four exact receipt hashes and rejects stale price and mutated caller inputs. The positive cancellation control confirms that two individually failing transfers can cancel. Hosted checks are pending at submission.

## Credit

#7314 and #7113 supply the complete comparison and signed caller. #7317 supplies the one-transfer stock and invoice. #7315 and #7298 supply the signed decoder and directed tariff. Credit #7309, #7296, #3204 and #1324 for related methods and distinct scopes. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted.

## Open next questions

Three or four simultaneous transfers and changed intervals remain open. Price the new full scope, then test the signed arbitrary-input endpoint. Any survivor also needs uniform multi-stage signed binding, dirty restoration and complete physical cost.
